ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central fluke to low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous light-intensity region covering the interior fluke surface; bounded by a continuous high-contrast black band along the entire trailing edge; small, isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (spots) localized in the lower-central region near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree angle; depth extends into a narrow, dark-pigmented cleft.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes; right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe; distal tips show extreme pixel-level irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured grey/white clusters present on both extreme distal tips, indicative of heavy calcified colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, dark linear pixel tracks visible on the upper-right quadrant of the fluke surface, intersecting the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular gouges and significant missing tissue segments along the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective), creating a jagged profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of three distinct dark spots arranged in a triangular pattern near the lower-central vertical axis of the visible fluke.
